questions.cardText:
[Music] Which of the following characterizes the “major scale”?
A. It is a series of whole steps
B. It typically sounds happy and bright
C. It follows the Dorian mode
Answer: B. The major scale is a specific pattern of whole and half steps that typically sounds happy and bright.
questions.de: Welche Abfolge von Ganz- und Halbtonschritten hat eine Dur-Tonleiter, die Tonleiter, die gemeinhin als fröhlich und hell klingend beschrieben wird?
questions.en: What is the sequence of whole and half steps in a major scale, the scale commonly described as sounding happy and bright?
questions.answerDe: Ganz, ganz, halb, ganz, ganz, ganz, halb
questions.answerEn: Whole, whole, half, whole, whole, whole, half

timeline.labelEn: Heinrich Glarean names the Ionian mode on C, the mode identical to the major scale
timeline.labelDe: Heinrich Glarean benennt den ionischen Modus auf C, der der Dur-Tonleiter entspricht

questions.notes: The card's 'happy and bright' is a Western cultural convention, not a defining property (Wikipedia's Major scale article does not say it), so the open question asks the defining interval pattern its explanation mentions. Option A is wrong (a series of only whole steps is the whole-tone scale). Timeline from Wikipedia, Ionian mode.

questions.cardText:
[Economics] McDonaldization refers to:
A. Principles of the fast-food industry that have grown to dominate more sectors of society
B. Fast food’s replacement of traditional cuisine
C. The global domination of chain stores
Answer: A. This concept highlights how principles like efficiency, calculability, predictability, and control have come to dominate many aspects of societal organization, sometimes at the expense of creativity and traditional practices.
questions.de: Welchen Begriff prägte der Soziologe George Ritzer für die Ausbreitung der Prinzipien des Fast-Food-Restaurants – Effizienz, Berechenbarkeit, Vorhersagbarkeit und Kontrolle – auf immer mehr Bereiche der Gesellschaft?
questions.en: What term did sociologist George Ritzer coin for the spread of the fast-food restaurant's principles — efficiency, calculability, predictability and control — into ever more sectors of society?

timeline.labelEn: George Ritzer publishes The McDonaldization of Society
timeline.labelDe: George Ritzer veröffentlicht „The McDonaldization of Society“

questions.notes: Card confirmed. The concept is sociological rather than economic; Ritzer first proposed it in a 1983 article and developed it in his 1993 book.
